svg.title: The eleven loop
svg.desc: 0 Intake: product writes brief.md, you approve. 1 Plan: the CTO writes plan.md and tasks. 2 Explore: notes.md, no code. 3 Manage: the CTO picks one task for one role. 4 Execute: a fresh worker does it and writes a report. 5 Verify: QA checks every criterion; a red check goes back to Manage, at most 10 rounds. 6 Ship: you accept, then merge and release.
